text:
sqlpipe copy Postgres table into Parquet file, push to S3. Command-line tool, one job.

Point sqlpipe at source table and target S3 bucket, tool run query, convert result to Parquet format, upload file. sqlpipe read connection settings from a config file or command-line flag. Sync run once or on schedule, with option to sync only new or changed rows since last run.

Output work with common Parquet readers: Athena, Redshift Spectrum, DuckDB, Spark.
